evals.prompt: Review the current android-re-mcp diff before I push. Write a dated review summary under reports/ with findings, evidence, and test counts. Don't change code yet.
evals.expected_output: A reports/SUMMARY-YYYY-MM-DD.md with the run date in the filename and title, scoped findings at file:line, test evidence, a verdict, limitations, and confirmation that reports/ is ignored.
assertions: Creates reports/SUMMARY-YYYY-MM-DD.md with the run date in the filename
Includes the date in the report title and metadata
Lists findings with severity, confidence, file:line, evidence, and impact
Runs targeted and full tests and reports passed/failed/skipped counts
Gives a verdict using the APPROVE / APPROVE WITH NITS / REQUEST CHANGES / BLOCK rubric
Ensures reports/ is ignored by git
Does not modify product code or push

evals.prompt: Review the 1.8.0 deferred-dex changes (dex_validate, dex_merge, cdex opt-in). If you agree with the review findings, make the fixes, add tests, run the full suite, and update the dated report. Stop before pushing.
evals.expected_output: A dated report, agreed fixes applied with tests, a green full suite, updated verification, and an explicit push-status line saying nothing was committed or pushed.
assertions: Writes reports/SUMMARY-YYYY-MM-DD.md with the run date
Reviews dex_validate, dex_merge, and cdex opt-in behavior and wiring
Applies only findings it explicitly agrees with and explains any declined finding
Adds or updates tests for each behavioral fix
Runs the full suite and reports the final counts
Updates the same dated report with Changes made and Verification
States that nothing was committed or pushed
